base_member_text: [L1-L3] (LOW/packaging-staleness) The package metadata enables tag_svn_revision, a legacy Subversion-oriented egg_info setting, despite the repository's build scaffolding otherwise being autotools/Visual Studio based; its active consumer and intended release behavior are unclear.
audit_member_text: [L2-L3] (LOW/package-version-contract) Package metadata always appends a development tag and requests SVN revision tagging, leaving release and non-SVN version behavior dependent on legacy setuptools handling.
